title: Line sketch: Viral Stasis Dog
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A large tricolor dog with long flowing black and fur stands centered, tongue out, surrounded by multiple hands holding smartphones. The phones display the same dog and are chained to its neck. A swirling vortex of TikTok logos, hearts, fire emojis, and running horses emanates from the dog's head against a psychedelic mountain backdrop (derived from generated still #2311).
